description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.tldr: You can cast divine spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability, drawing power from your deity.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.tldr: Choose a domain related to your deity, granting you specialized spells and features.

features.name: Channel Divinity (1/rest)
features.tldr: Channel divine energy directly to fuel magical effects like turning undead.

features.name: Divine Domain Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized Channel Divinity option granted by your chosen domain.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1/2 or lower)
features.tldr: When your Turn Undead successfully turns undead of a certain challenge rating, they are instantly destroyed.

features.name: Channel Divinity (2/rest)
features.tldr: You can use your Channel Divinity feature twice between rests.

features.name: Divine Domain Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Divine Domain.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1 or lower)
features.tldr: The threshold for instantly destroying turned undead increases to CR 1.

features.name: Divine Domain Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Divine Domain.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.tldr: Implore your deity directly to intercede on your behalf when facing dire circumstances.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 2 or lower)
features.tldr: The threshold for instantly destroying turned undead increases to CR 2.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 3 or lower)
features.tldr: The threshold for instantly destroying turned undead increases to CR 3.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 4 or lower)
features.tldr: The threshold for instantly destroying turned undead increases to CR 4.

features.name: Divine Domain Feature
features.tldr: Gain the capstone feature granted by your chosen Divine Domain.

features.name: Channel Divinity (3/rest)
features.tldr: You can use your Channel Divinity feature three times between rests.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Divine Intervention Improvement
features.tldr: Your call for divine intervention automatically succeeds without needing a percentile roll.
